name: Claygent
description: Claygent is Clay's AI-agent builder for judgment-based go-to-market work such as account research, lead scoring, outbound copywriting, and persona classification.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned Clay Public API key to validate the exact workspace intended for external Claygent setup. V1 exposes only the stable, bounded GET /public/v0/me authority check. Relay does not execute Claygents because Clay documents no stable Claygent-specific direct API contract; prompts, models, browsing, research, sources, connected providers, outputs, citations, production data, Functions, Workflows Alpha, Routines, MCP/CLI, credit spend, mutations, polling, batch work, and exports remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.label: Clay Public API key for Claygent

approvalRequired.label: Read connected workspace
approvalRequired.description: Validate the exact Clay API-key-bound workspace for future Claygent setup without returning personal identity, agent configuration, prompts, sources, outputs, or GTM data.

blocked.label: Run Claygent research
blocked.description: Claygent execution, testing, deployment, prompts, model selection, browsing, research, classification, scoring, copywriting, and credit or Action consumption are outside V1 because no stable Claygent-specific Public API contract is documented.

blocked.label: Read private Claygent configuration
blocked.description: Agents, prompts, business context, documents, connected sources, provider connections, production data, outputs, citations, histories, and evaluations are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Claygents
blocked.description: Building, editing, testing, deploying, sharing, or deleting Claygents, Functions, Workflows, tables, or integrations is outside V1.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary Clay surfaces
blocked.description: Routines, Workflows Alpha, Searches, Tables, raw Public API, MCP, CLI, plugin, arbitrary paths, methods, payloads, and undocumented Claygent endpoints are outside V1.

blocked.label: Export Claygent data
blocked.description: Batch runs, uploads, webhooks, polling, pagination, crawling, synchronization, downloads, and exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded private workspace-binding read requires matching approval; Claygent execution remains blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The workspace-binding read runs without Relay approval, but Claygent execution and every unstable, private, mutating, credit-consuming, raw, bulk, or export surface remain hard-blocked.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Clay account/Public API key, configured Claygent, stable Claygent-specific direct API contract, or live acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, create a dedicated Clay Public API key, validate the intended workspace, build and permission the Claygent externally, and monitor official developer documentation for a stable Claygent-specific direct API. Do not enable Relay execution until its exact identifier, input/output schema, pricing, polling, redaction, and revocation contract can be pinned and accepted.

evidence.supports: Clay describes Claygent builder, judgment-based GTM use cases, prompts, business context, documents, testing, production-data deployment, and workflow reuse.
Clay documents its open-beta developer platform and API, CLI, MCP, Searches, Routines, and Enterprise Tables; it does not expose a Claygent-specific reference endpoint.
Clay documents routines for enrichment, research, scoring, routing, and repeatable GTM work, with custom functions available and Workflows still Alpha.
Clay documents that AI/enrichment work consumes Data Credits or provider spend plus Actions, supporting approval and cost withholding.
